headings.usage: Massive kinetic hero text, section headers, numbered manifesto chapters. Tracking tight.

body.usage: Case study paragraphs, descriptions, legible content.

mono.usage: Overlines, statistics, metrics, terminal output, UI metadata, code blocks.

scale.mono_small: text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-mono text-emerald-400

visual_enhancers.terminal_look: bg-black border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 font-mono relative overflow-hidden

layouts.hero: Full viewport height. Massive text filling the screen. Extreme asymmetry. 3D nodes behind the text.
layouts.spacing: Generous padding (py-24 to py-32) for sections. Internal card padding p-8 or p-12.
layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for text. Intentional offset elements to break the grid.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal on load. Text lines wrapped in overflow-hidden spans, translating Y from 100% to 0% with ease-[0.76,0,0.24,1] duration 1s.
motion.scroll_animations: Elements fade and translate up slightly on entering viewport using Framer Motion whileInView. Staggered children for lists/grids.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. Massive outline text (text-transparent stroke-white/20) bridging sections.
motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-2), borders glow emerald, glass opacity slightly increases.

3d_libraries.usage: Use tsparticles for a subtle floating green/cyan network nodes effect behind the Hero section to represent Multi-Agent AI and Neural Networks without blocking text. Ensure absolute positioning with z-[-1].

hero.content: Headline: GENERATIVE AI / AGENTIC SYSTEMS. Name: Archi Singhal. Value Prop, CTAs.
hero.style: Kinetic typography. 3D particles background. Signature line-by-line load reveal.

marquee.content: NLP // RAG // DEEP LEARNING // MULTI-AGENT PIPELINES // COMPUTER VISION //
marquee.style: Kinetic text, border-y border-white/10, massive text.

technical_skills.content: Frameworks, ML Architectures, Cloud/MLOps, Languages, Databases.
technical_skills.style: Bento grid of glassmorphic cards. Use pure mono font for lists. Add small green glowing dots next to each skill.

featured_projects.content: Multi-Agent AI News Explainer, RAG-Based KMS (IJACECT).
featured_projects.style: Case-study style. Large images, explicit metrics, tags. 'Aceternity' style tracing beam borders for project cards.

interactive_ai.content: Live prompt-testing playground powered by simulated AI or real API. Terminal-style UI.
interactive_ai.style: macOS window dots, pure black bg, scanlines, typing effect for AI response. User can type a prompt.

experience.style: A central glowing green line. Nodes that light up on scroll. Left/right alternating cards.

footer.content: Contact form (real email via Formspree/Resend/etc), Socials, Resume PDF download.
footer.style: Massive 'LET'S BUILD' text. Strict terminal-style form inputs (bottom border only or strict sharp boxes).

component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp corners or highly pill-shaped. No in-between. Terminal style: border border-emerald-400 text-emerald-400 bg-transparent hover:bg-emerald-400 hover:text-black transition-colors.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized to dark mode. No background, just a sharp bottom border focus:border-emerald-400, or full glassmorphism.
component_guidelines.cards: Never use default Shadcn Card. Use raw div with glassmorphism utility classes and inner border.
component_guidelines.badges: font-mono text-xs border border-white/20 rounded-full px-3 py-1 bg-white/5

abstract_network.description: Green and red network nodes. Use with heavy opacity overlay or mix-blend-mode to avoid clashing with text.

terminal_texture.description: Cyberpunk terminal text texture. Use at 5-10% opacity inside the interactive AI terminal card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute an Awwwards-level, dark-mode first design. Do not produce a standard, generic SaaS look.
Integrate Framer Motion for scroll reveals, ensuring a massive, masked line-by-line reveal on the hero section.
Install and configure 'lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Install 'tsparticles' for the hero background to create a tech/AI neural network feel.
Install 'react-fast-marquee' for the editorial scrolling text.
Use Cabinet Grotesk, JetBrains Mono, and Satoshi as your font stack. Include them via Google Fonts or Fontshare.
Ensure the Interactive AI playground is fully styled as a functional terminal window with a typing effect.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; apply heavy glassmorphism.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the grid. Use 2-3x more spacing.
NEVER center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center }).
Use layered shadows, glassmorphism, and explicit z-indexes.
Implement micro-animations for every hover state.
Do not use generic emoji icons. Use Lucide icons.
